title: Training Agents 2: Live tutorial on model distillation for training custom agents.
summary: In this live session, we'll cover how to transfer capability from a teacher model to a smaller student through distillation. We'll work through supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated data, then on-policy and online methods where the teacher scores the student live, then self-distillation where the model teaches itself. Each one runs in TRL.

extra.full_text: In this live session, we'll cover how to transfer capability from a teacher model to a smaller student through distillation. We'll work through supervised fine-tuning on teacher-generated data, then on-policy and online methods where the teacher scores the student live, then self-distillation where the model teaches itself. Each one runs in TRL. What we'll cover: - What distillation is, and the four axes that organize it: signal, data source, timing, and teacher identity - White-box vs black-box: distilling from open weights vs strings - Off-policy distillation: generate from the teacher, then SFT on the outputs - On-policy distillation: sample from the student, score with the teacher in the loop - Distillation as reinforcement learning: the KD distance as a dense, token-level reward - Self-distillation: the model as its own teacher, and when that beats a stronger one Repo: https://github.com/burtenshaw/training-agents This is part of the Training Agents series: using coding agents to design, run, monitor, and review post-training experiments, while training models to become better agents. #TRL #HuggingFace #PostTraining #AIAgents #Distillation

title: Sabanto Inc. and Verdant Robotics Announce Technical Integration of Autonomous Tractor Operation with SharpShooter Plant-Level Precision Application
summary: Sabanto and Verdant Robotics have integrated Sabanto’s autonomous tractor operation with Verdant’s SharpShooter plant-level application system, so a tractor can navigate fields and apply treatments to individual plants without an operator in the cab. The combination matters because it links autonomy at the vehicle level with precision action at the crop level, turning robotic field operation into a more complete end-to-end workflow rather than a set of separate tools.

extra.full_text: The two systems now operate as a single, integrated solution, enabling fully autonomous field work from navigation to plant-level application without an operator in the cab.

title: ANRA Technologies Surpasses 55,000 Commercial Drone Operations Per Month, Demonstrating Growing Demand for Digital Airspace Infrastructure
summary: ANRA Technologies says its platform is now supporting more than 55,000 commercial drone operations per month, including over 1,800 beyond-visual-line-of-sight flights per day. The volume spans delivery, critical infrastructure, utilities, and public-sector missions, pointing to growing operational demand for digital airspace infrastructure that can coordinate routine drone activity at commercial scale.

extra.full_text: Platform now enables more than 1,800 beyond visual line of sight commercial drone operations every day across delivery, critical infrastructure, utilities and public sector missions

title: Robot safety is now 3D: Sonair unveils world's first safety-certified 3D ultrasonic sensor for human-robot collaboration
summary: Sonair’s ADAR One 3D ultrasonic sensor has been certified for SIL2 and PL d safety applications, meeting European machinery directive requirements for detecting humans and objects around collaborative robots. The practical significance is that ultrasonic sensing can now be used as a safety-rated 3D perception layer in human-robot workspaces, potentially giving cobots more reliable proximity awareness without relying only on vision or lidar.

extra.full_text: The ADAR One sensor is now suitable for SIL2 and PL d applications and is certified to fulfil all requirements of the European machine directive as a sensor for the safe detection of humans and objects.

summary: Loen Surgical signed an MOU with U.S.-based Sovato to explore integrating Loen’s precision AI surgical robot technology with Sovato’s remote-surgery network platform.
